candidate_records.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. REPAINT the first image without moving its walls, corners or ground outline. It is a locked camera/layout render, not a loose reference. Texture these existing straight white walls with fine aged plaster, dark gray tile caps and pale stone footings; put a Ming Jiangnan county yamen main timber hall at rear and two low small side office halls inside them. Small roofed gate centered on the long left-front wall, doorway opening and steps contained inside boundary. Image2 supplies only design/material/detail density, its ground geometry must NOT be copied. This is a finely realistic Chinese historical city-map sprite, understated natural white plaster/dark clay tiles/chestnut timber, individual roof tiles and worn stone, upper-left sun, no broad cast shadow. CRITICAL preserve the first image camera and footprint EXACTLY; both ground edges slope +/-0.5, four parallel orthographic axes; the left-front visible side is16m, right-front13m. KEEP the existing pixel positions left=(128,570), front=(834,923), right=(1408,636), back=(702,283). Do not stretch, rotate, enlarge, recenter or invent a different front corner. All structures use the same axes. Whole base must remain a simple quadrilateral. Remove diagram grid, replace with realistic natural paving. True alpha transparent background preserved; no halo, fog, backdrop, labels, text, people, modern elements, yellow tiles, watermarks. Preserve generous margins and whole roofs. Do not show any technical guides.

candidate_records.prompt: Repaint this exact shape as a fine realistic historical game sprite. Preserve its straight base and its camera: DO NOT MOVE ANY OF THE FOUR WALL CORNERS. Add Ming Chinese Jiangnan yamen buildings WITHIN the footprint: a low timber main hall to rear and two little side offices, dark grey tiled roofs, chalk white plaster, finely detailed wood and stone. Small gate halfway down long front wall, no stairs outside. Realistic hand-built textures like a high-quality historical architectural miniature, natural muted colors, upper-left sunlight. KEEP the original bottom outline precisely: BOTH visible long edges are at 26.565 degrees to horizontal, equal and opposite slopes; do not change their lengths or make one steeper. All roofs follow these SAME parallel axes. Do NOT change crop, position, camera or canvas. Preserve the shape pixel-exact, just paint realistic materials and place architecture within. No people, text, numbers, modern elements. Actual transparent alpha outside subject, no gradient halo. Low walls and low buildings, no tall towers. No lines or diagram annotations in finished image.
